source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = min(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    dots = [x for row in grid for x in row if x != bg]
    if not dots:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    dot = dots[0]
    line = dot - 1 if dot > 0 else 0
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == dot]
        if len(cols) > 1:
            for c in range(cols[0] + 1, cols[-1]):
                if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = line
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == dot]
        if len(rows) > 1:
            for r in range(rows[0] + 1, rows[-1]):
                if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = line
    return out
'''
